# Page evidence report

Source: https://example.com/research
Fetched: 2026-10-20T10:00:00.000Z

Static HTML evidence and editorial review prompts, not an AEO score, ranking prediction, citation tracker, or verification of claims. Missing optional signals do not prove poor quality. No llms.txt or FAQ requirement.

## Review priorities
1. **MEDIUM — attribution**: No explicit author markup detected. Where readers expect attribution, identify the responsible author or organization and explain relevant experience.
2. **MEDIUM — source-links**: 0 external links in the bounded main-content inventory. These may not be citations; destinations and claims are not verified. Link to relevant supporting evidence for factual claims where useful; external links are not a mandatory quota.
3. **MEDIUM — social-image**: No valid HTTP(S) Open Graph image reference found. Add a relevant public HTTP(S) Open Graph image reference if a sharing image is useful; verify the image separately.
4. **LOW — dates**: No machine-readable date found. For time-sensitive content, show an accurate publication/update date. Do not change dates without meaningful changes.

## Measurements
37 word tokens; 0.2 estimated reading minutes.

## Measurement outside this report
Use verified search-console data for indexing and search traffic. Measure AI citations separately with reproducible observations. Verify claims, authorship and structured-data accuracy manually.
